conditionalCandidate: New disposable single-control-plane kind cluster on a proven local container runtime; separate Linux fixture executor on a fixture-only internal network
notAnExistingApprovedEnvironment: Existing kind/orbstack contexts must not be reused

strictRequestedOneNamespaceOneSecret.reason: Original loop always visits four targets and requireLease uses data-infra; source/namespace overrides do not exist. Cannot replace this by one target without changing Gate or using a fake validator.

minimumForUnchangedGate.namespaceMeaning: Names mirror hardcoded names but all must be owned test namespaces in a newly proven isolated cluster, never resources in production
minimumForUnchangedGate.additionalNegativeTargetSecrets: NONE; negative auth can-i targets need no Secret values or objects
minimumForUnchangedGate.rbac: Only original named Secret get (+ named patch if later testing original apply branch), verifier own credential get; list/create/foreign namespace access denied. Fixture execution identity needs only required Lease read and exact two-identity impersonation. New cluster bootstrap authorization is not to be borrowed from production. All actual RBAC behavior must be verified in that isolated cluster.
minimumForUnchangedGate.workingDirectory: Disposable allowlisted workspace; original Gate/runtime/tool manifest/lock copied byte-identically, synthetic encrypted inputs at original relative paths; never copy production ciphertext/key/.kube/.aws/.ssh/home
minimumForUnchangedGate.toolchain: Existing trusted Linux/arm64 Node/kubectl + exact locked SOPS bytes at original absolute root inside disposable executor. age/age-keygen for synthetic fixture construction only. No host path widening or local fake binaries. Tool images/cache availability unproven; no pulls or installs now.
minimumForUnchangedGate.keyPath: BUSINESS_AGE_FILE points only to freshly generated disposable fixture identity; never production Jenkins file credential
minimumForUnchangedGate.kubeconfig: Fresh single-cluster fixture-only file; fixed trusted CA/server mapped to owned local cluster; no users.exec/auth-provider, proxy entry, default kubeconfig merging, or skip TLS
minimumForUnchangedGate.environment: Sanitized child env and empty HOME; no real cloud/SSH/Kubernetes/SOPS credentials inherited; age-only synthetic ciphertext, no external KMS
minimumForUnchangedGate.network: Dedicated owned internal container network; no production credentials mounted, no host Docker socket or SSH agent in executor. No external production API connectivity; prove network/container ownership rather than changing host/global routing.

identityProofBeforeGateExecution: Prove local runtime endpoint identity and state; do not rely on CLI/context name
Use only a separately authorized new disposable cluster, with exact container/VM ID, owned network, no production mounts and local-only API mapping
Match fixture kubeconfig server/TLS CA to this exact cluster; reject credential plugins/proxy/default-config fallback
Only after preliminary runtime/network/TLS identity is proved, query its kube-system UID and fixture namespace UID/sentinel; record fresh IDs and ensure not equal known production UID
Refuse execution on any uncertainty; never test the existing orbstack/SSH endpoint
futureProductionPathReuse: Run original scanner-runtime import + manifest/Lease/tool SHA prerequisites in the real isolated executor
Run byte-identical secrets-gate.mjs using real SOPS decrypt and real isolated Kubernetes Secret/RBAC reads
Capture real execution exit, prerequisite outcomes and equality/UID/RBAC observations without substituting return values or secret-bearing logs
Feed those same synthetic-only execution facts in memory to existing SOPS adapter and baseline-v1/standard; compare old/standard decisions
If instrumentation is needed, separately review observational delegation only; no second validator, VM mock or manufactured positive result
cleanupPlan: Before creating anything in a future phase, record exact owned cluster/container/network/volume IDs and fixture root
Stop executor; remove only recorded disposable cluster/container/network/volumes after rechecking ownership labels/IDs
Delete synthetic age private key, kubeconfig and fixture plaintext/ciphertext; retain only scrubbed execution evidence and hashes
Never delete by broad name pattern, run kind delete against an unverified context, reset kubectl global context, or touch existing production resources

codeChangesRequired.forFullIsolatedMirror: No production behavior/source change expected; exact tool paths and hardcoded fixture identities must be supplied inside isolated environment. This is not yet execution-proven.
codeChangesRequired.forOneNamespaceOneSecret: Would need forbidden target/namespace parameterization or skipped targets; not proposed or performed.
